title: Actionist module contract family
design_note: Seven records replace the single monolithic Block Contract v1. Separation rule: a field belongs to the record whose OWNER can change it without invalidating the others. Capability semantics change when the product meaning changes; packaging changes when the delivery shape changes; host requirements change when the host evolves; a binding changes per application; qualification changes per proof run; registry changes per governance act; release changes per deployment. v1 fused all seven, so any proof re-run mutated the semantic interface a composer reads. That is the defect this family fixes.

inherited_defects_fixed.defect: Block Contract v1 id regex ^[a-z0-9-]+/[a-z0-9-]+@1\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ hardcodes major version 1, making any v2 id unrepresentable.
inherited_defects_fixed.fix: CapabilityContract.capability_id pattern admits any major version.

inherited_defects_fixed.defect: v0 required requires:[block-ids]; v1 dropped the inter-module dependency edge entirely while composition is the goal.
inherited_defects_fixed.fix: CapabilityContract.requires_capabilities restores a typed dependency edge; BindingPlan resolves it per application.

inherited_defects_fixed.defect: Great Library license.status has 3 values and cannot represent ambiguous/incompatible — the two states that must block reuse. Projecting them as pending erases a rights refusal.
inherited_defects_fixed.fix: RegistryRecord.projection_policy forbids projecting a module whose rights_state is ambiguous or incompatible, rather than downgrading it.

inherited_defects_fixed.defect: No receipt_type existed for source identity, dependency closure or shape decision — exactly the stages that gate everything downstream.
inherited_defects_fixed.fix: QualificationDossier.receipt_type adds source_identity, dependency_closure, shape_decision, transform_applied.

inherited_defects_fixed.defect: v1 admission.admitted_scope is a free nullable string, so a scope-less admission reads as universal.
inherited_defects_fixed.fix: RegistryRecord.admission_scope is a required structured object; absent scope means NOT admitted anywhere.

CapabilityContract.purpose: What the module means to the product. The ONLY record a composer reads to decide semantic fit. Contains no runtime, no proof, no rights, no host detail.
CapabilityContract.mutability_rule: Changes only when product meaning changes. A proof re-run, a repin, or a host upgrade MUST NOT edit this record.

capability_id.description: Fixes X-1: any major version representable.

capability_kind.description: v1 six retained; workflow and agent_capability from UBF §3.1; surface and engine added by P04 because P03 measured the product/framework/primitive split as the decisive supply distinction (case/workflow: 7 runnable products, 0 clean-permissive; engine layer solved under Apache-2.0). An engine is a primitive with no UI/identity/workflow; a surface is the product-defining UI+vocabulary layer.

outcome_statement.description: The client-visible outcome in one sentence, written without naming the donor. If it cannot be written without the donor's name, the boundary is wrong.

external_effect.description: Highest-stakes SEMI judgment per repo-to-block §3.6. A port typed read-only that writes defeats every downstream authority control.

idempotency_key_source.description: Required non-null when external_effect is write_external or irreversible_external.

requires_host.description: Names host services needed. Does NOT describe how they are provided — that is HostContract.

requires_capabilities.description: Fixes X-2: restores the v0 dependency edge v1 dropped.

state_classes.description: The nine classes P09 established. The classification, not the database, is the unit of decision.

authoritative_owner.description: Invariant A11: one owner per table and migration, never two.

authority_class.description: Composition rule C4: a composition's scope is the INTERSECTION of members, never the union. S2-L4 RECONCILIATION (accepted 2026-08-27): this is a CAPABILITY-shaped summary and is NOT the same axis as the AssemblyPlan's session-shaped authority_level ladder (read|stage|write|message|deploy). L4 identified a real defect in this field: the class can DISAGREE with port-level external_effect — a read_only class whose port declares external_effect != none. RESOLUTION: the port-level external_effect is AUTHORITATIVE; authority_class is a summary. Where they disagree the STRICTER wins and the disagreement is reported as an `authority` UNDERDETERMINED against this contract rather than silently resolved. Minimum session ceiling per class is owned by L4's compatibility-and-authority-rules.json, not restated here, to avoid two truths.

PackagingProfile.purpose: How the capability is delivered from the source. Decided once; not revisable without restarting conversion.
PackagingProfile.mutability_rule: Changes only by an explicit re-shape decision, which restarts qualification.

reuse_shape.description: P04 RECONCILIATION: the knowledge spine names 8 shapes, UBF §3.2 names 5 packaging_modes, and repo-to-block §2 names 4 rights-oriented shapes S1-S4. These were three different vocabularies for two different axes. This enum is the single reuse-shape axis; the S1-S4 axis is preserved separately as rights_exposure below, because S1-S4 actually classify HOW MUCH SOURCE IS COPIED, not what the module is.

rights_exposure.description: The repo-to-block S1-S4 axis, restated as what it measures. Orthogonal to reuse_shape: an intact_service copies nothing (none_network_only) while a transplant copies source.

immutable_revision.description: A commit SHA or a tag resolved to one. A branch name is NOT an identity and is rejected.

identity_status.description: Measured Phase 7 state for the whole corpus was NOT_CAPTURED. Identity, not rights, is the first blocker.

rights_state.description: Six values retained from v1. ambiguous and incompatible MUST NOT be projected to the registry as pending (fixes X-4).

dependency_closure_state.description: Transitive, not the direct manifest. Measured failure mode: the 21st component's true closure reached @radix-ui/react-slot and cva, not named in its own metadata.

upstream_sync_model.description: SISOCRM test: would upstream ever ship something here we would actually want? Yes -> stay downstream. No -> take the code and stop pretending the merge exists.

HostContract.purpose: What the Actionist host guarantees to every module. One record per host version, NOT per module.
HostContract.mutability_rule: Changes only on a host release. Modules declare requires_host against a host_contract_version.

token_model.description: P10 finding A: four independent commercial forms converge on two tokens — a long-lived credential only the host backend holds, and a short-lived per-user token that crosses the boundary. Wix is the counter-example that proves it: a signed instance in a QUERY PARAMETER whose plain-text instanceId its own docs warn is attacker-manipulable.

lifetime_seconds.description: SISOCRM Ed25519 contract: 60-120s, audience-bound, single-use jti.

combination_rule.description: Cerbos's two selectable modes. P10: every mature surface has a hierarchy AND a stated conflict rule; making the rule an explicit per-node field with a safe default is the transferable idea.

donor_settings_policy.description: P10 HEADLINE RISK: after 33 commercial surfaces, ZERO render a third party's settings inside host-owned chrome. Zoho One and Microsoft 365 unify identity and admin and explicitly do NOT suppress donor chrome. host_rendered is a research bet, not an engineering estimate. Default for v1 is donor_rendered_behind_host_nav.

contribution_model.description: P10 gap: Luigi has the declarative node data structure (~45 params, visibleForFeatureToggles, userSettingsGroup) but NO contribution model — one tree in the host's own config file. Backstage has decentralized contribution but emits a React element, not a declarative record, and is welded to its CLI/webpack. Neither has both. Actionist must build the whole.

cascading_emptiness.description: Salesforce behavior: hide every component in a tab and the tab goes; hide every tab and the container goes. Without it, entitlement-stripping a donor leaves empty chrome.

url_authority.description: P10 §2: observed WITHOUT EXCEPTION across every surface. A route-reconciliation handshake at absorption time is a requirement, not a refinement.

capability_identifier.description: P14: stable, survives redeploy, identical across deploy system and telemetry. Deliberately PLURAL where the app is one thing but the capabilities are many — the inverse of New Relic's consolidate-to-one-entity advice.

per_capability_release_correlation.description: Must be per capability, not per app. Rollbar's suspect-deploy heuristic ('last deploy prior to first occurrence') systematically blames the wrong capability when capabilities deploy independently — which Actionist does by design. App-level correlation is actively misleading, not merely weaker.

trace_propagation.description: Buys dependency-level attribution; only 4 of 29 surveyed observability surfaces reach it. FAILS SILENTLY: an uninstrumented capability does not appear as a gap, it simply does not appear.

BindingPlan.purpose: How one capability binds into ONE application. The per-application record; the only place a module and a host meet concretely.
BindingPlan.mutability_rule: Changes per application and per composition revision. Never edits CapabilityContract.

migration_authority.description: Exactly one named owner per resource. Teable brief: Prisma (Teable) vs Django (Plane) — one owner per table, never two.

cross_owner_reads.description: A12: cross-owner VIEWS use events/read models; cross-owner MUTATION is forbidden. SISOCRM's honest cost: 'which buyers signed an NDA and viewed the CIM' cannot be one query.

exceeded_action.description: Stage 6 negative path adaptation_unbounded: a change set exceeding the ratio is a rewrite wearing a codemod's clothes.

items.description: The UNDERDETERMINED channel. A15 invariant: unknown compatibility returns UNDERDETERMINED; it never becomes model confidence.

QualificationDossier.purpose: Evidence about a capability at a pinned artifact and environment. Linked to, never fused into, the semantic contract.
QualificationDossier.mutability_rule: Append-only. A later green receipt binds a NEW artifact/environment, never retroactively an old one.

evidence_tier.description: ANTI-AVERAGING RULE (UBF §10): evidence_tier may never exceed the MINIMUM tier across the nine families. A single T1 family pins the whole module at T1 regardless of eight T4s.

receipt_type.description: v1's 14 plus the four P04 additions closing the repo-to-block §6 gaps: source_identity, shape_decision, dependency_closure, transform_applied (split from transform_boundary because Stage 4 is DET and Stage 6 is SEMI and they must not share a type).

status.description: deferred adopted from siso-ui-base principles-grep: a gate that cannot distinguish 'violation' from 'legitimately overridden by tenant DNA' will either block valid work or wave through real violations.

families_reported.description: The nine orthogonal families F1-F9. INV-ORTHOGONAL: no family's pass may be DERIVED from another's. INV-FAIL-CLOSED: admitted requires all nine pass. INV-DEFAULT: absent evidence keeps not_admitted or reference_only, never admitted.

RegistryRecord.purpose: Governance identity across modules and collections. Registry-level acts: scope, supersession, revocation.
RegistryRecord.mutability_rule: Changes by an explicit governance act with a named principal.

admission_scope.description: Fixes SCOPE-HOLE: structured and required. A module admitted for tenant A is NOT admitted for tenant B. An absent scope means admitted NOWHERE, not everywhere.

revocation_propagation.description: On revoke, every assembly whose components include this module MUST reopen to held.

refuse_projection_when.description: Fixes X-4. Projecting a rights refusal as 'pending' erases it. Refuse the projection instead of downgrading it.

lossy_flagged.description: Great Library projection loses falsifiers and limitations (14 required receipt fields -> 4) and has no target for transformation history. Never treat as round-trippable.

ReleaseManifest.purpose: The exact deployed composition and its recovery path.
ReleaseManifest.mutability_rule: Immutable once released. A change mints a new manifest.

object_kind.description: P14 primary finding, derived twice independently: rollback is NOT one object. Vercel does not revert env vars or configuration; Fly does not revert fly.toml, secrets or migrations; SISOCRM's operated standard says 'Data rollback is separate' and names a third object no vendor surfaced — a standing alternate UI route (/tables-native while /tables is canonical). RollbackPlan cannot be a boolean.

recovery_horizon_seconds.description: The MINIMUM horizon across all objects — PlanetScale's schema revert is a ~30-minute dual-write window while artifact rollback is unbounded. Computed and displayed AT RELEASE TIME, not discovered during an incident.

artifact_retention.description: P14: a pin is not a pin. Render re-pulls by TAG on rollback and may get a different image; Fly prunes images not recently deployed. A pinned reference to an artifact a third party may garbage-collect is not a recovery path.

composition_rules.C1_port_typing: Every wired output->input pair has compatible schema_ref, or the binding is UNDERDETERMINED.
composition_rules.C2_tenancy_agreement: All composed modules share one tenant_key or declare an explicit bridge.
composition_rules.C3_token_single_source: All UI-bearing modules resolve tokens from ONE resolver context.
composition_rules.C4_authority_non_escalation: The composition's authority scope is the INTERSECTION of member scopes, never the union. The natural implementation (union) is exactly wrong and is where privilege escalation occurs.
composition_rules.C5_rights_compatibility: The composed licence expression is satisfiable; the strictest obligation governs.
composition_rules.C6_single_migration_owner: P04 ADDITION. No two modules in one composition may claim migration authority over the same resource. This is the only rule that SISOCRM proved by operating it rather than by reasoning about it.
composition_rules.C7_observability_identity: P04 ADDITION. Every composed module carries a distinct stable capability identifier before admission, enforced at admission time — not discovered at incident time that a capability is anonymous.

authority_axis_note.statement: authority_class (capability summary) and authority_level (session ceiling) are different shapes; the mapping must never be assumed.
authority_axis_note.resolution: Port-level external_effect is authoritative over the class summary; stricter wins; disagreement returns UNDERDETERMINED.

open_edges: stage ceiling deliberately maps to no capability class; P04 does not model a staged-but-unexecuted binding state
